purpose: Repair media source policy invalidation for container queries and opaque cross-origin stylesheets.
approach: Expose a separate completeness flag; matching declarations in container/scope conditions and opaque sheets cannot alone prove an unchanged author policy. Preserve the existing signature-only API for other layout consumers.

For incomplete media policy, read the browser cascade with the owned media rule omitted synchronously, restoring CSSOM declarations in finally. Compare source crop, content aspect ratio and unbounded height relationship, allowing normal translation growth and viewport reflow.
Use containing content width and the image CSS sizing box for percentage constraints; verify border and padding on both image and column.
restorationContract: No authored source nodes, attributes, styles or text are overwritten by media probes.
Only the owned CSSOM media rule is omitted synchronously during measurement, without yielding or DOM mutation records; all declarations are restored on exceptions.
Page edits and source transfers survive immediate restoration, repeated restoration and a switch between bilingual and replace modes.

preFixNative.reason: Owned media rule remained after author state changed.

The fallback validates observed media paint and shape; it is not a full CSS condition/cascade interpreter. Bounded min/max heights do not establish a proportional height relationship. CSSOM-only edits without observable events remain outside the update-trigger contract.
Chromium native regressions load the installed extension; Firefox uses native Gecko with fresh packaged content and the repository browser shim.
Performance checks use the default repository budgets rather than strict mode.
